name: On Your Day Off
source:
It's a beautiful summer day in San Lugos, and you've decided to take a personal day from work.  This is a day full of so many possibilities—you could meet up with friends, explore around town, go hiking, be lazy, or...well, who knows what else you might want to do? It's your day off, after all.

On Your Day Off is a furry, adult, gay-focused visual novella with you as the main character. You'll be a male jaguar who's getting his day started, and you'll need to figure out what activities you want to get up to. Your choices will shape what kind of day you have as you go around the city of San Lugos—you can take things easy or get involved in some seriously steamy scenes, depending on what you choose to do!

[From [url=https://runneroo.itch.io/on-your-day-off]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是圣卢戈斯一个美丽的夏日，你决定从工作中休息一天。这是充满多种可能性的一天——你可以与朋友见面、探索城镇、徒步旅行、偷懒，或者……好吧，谁知道你还想做什么？毕竟今天是你的休息日。

《On Your Day Off》是一部毛茸茸的、成人的、以同性恋为中心的视觉中篇小说，以你为主角。你将成为一只雄性美洲虎，开始新的一天，你需要弄清楚你想要做什么活动。你的选择将决定你在圣卢戈斯市游览时的一天——你可以轻松地度过，也可以参与一些非常火爆的场景，具体取决于你选择做什么！
